directions: Suppose the student union of your university is collecting opinions on improving its work far the coming year. You are now to write a response by suggesting how it can better enrich student life. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
I'm writing to offer some suggestions on how the student union can better enrich student life in the coming year. To begin with, the student union could organize more cultural exchange events. For example, hosting international food festivals or cultural showcases can expose students to diverse cultures, broadening their horizons. In addition, it should provide more sports activities. Setting up regular basketball, football, and badminton tournaments not only promotes physical health but also fosters teamwork among students. 

Furthermore, the union can establish more interest-based clubs. Whether it's a photography club for those loving to capture beautiful moments or a reading club for bookworms, these clubs can gather students with the same hobbies, allowing them to share and grow together. 

In conclusion, by organizing cultural events, providing sports activities, and establishing interest clubs, the student union can effectively enrich student life and create a more vibrant campus atmosphere.
